results.title: Hormuz Under Fire as a New Wave of Attacks Targets Ships
results.description: The risks facing maritime navigation in the Gulf are escalating, with an unprecedented rise in attacks on ships and oil tankers since the outbreak of the war. The latest developments are heightening concerns over the security of global energy supplies and pushing oil prices higher. As the United States and Iran trade military pressure around the Strait of Hormuz, the cost and risks of passage through the strategic waterway are increasing, amid uncertainty over the fate of negotiations aimed at ending the war.
